nodes.label: tokenizeLineStateful

nodes.label: '#'-word infinite loop bug
nodes.rationale: Outer gate /[A-Za-z_$#]/ includes '#' but inner scan /[A-Za-z0-9_$]/ does not, so any word starting with '#' outside a string/comment loops forever; pre-existing latent v0.6.1 bug, not a regression.

nodes.label: Security Audit CI job
nodes.rationale: Weekly cron (Mondays 03:17 UTC) running cargo audit; fails the workflow on known CVEs in Cargo.lock as CC7.1 evidence for the SOC 2 TSC mapping.

nodes.label: install.sh
nodes.rationale: Binary-first since v0.2.1 (DIST-007..010): detects platform, downloads matching prebuilt release binary and verifies its SHA-256 checksum so no Rust toolchain is required; compile-from-source runs only as an explicit fallback.

nodes.label: mux-web Server Binary
nodes.rationale: Single self-contained binary with the frontend compressed and embedded; zero runtime dependencies (no Node.js or Python required on host).

nodes.label: update.sh
nodes.rationale: Compares installed version against latest release, downloads and verifies the new binary, backs up the old one to mux-web.bak with automatic rollback on failure (DIST-011..012); never updates from main.

nodes.label: Single-Use Bootstrap Secret
nodes.rationale: Every session authenticated by default: startup generates a 32-byte CSPRNG bearer token printed as a pairing URL, exchanged once for an HTTP-only SameSite=Strict session cookie.

nodes.label: Dependency Audit (cargo audit)
nodes.rationale: CI runs cargo audit weekly and fails on known vulnerabilities.

nodes.label: DNS Rebinding Defense
nodes.rationale: Requests with invalid Origin or spoofed Host headers are automatically rejected with 403 Forbidden.

nodes.label: Loopback Default Binding
nodes.rationale: Binds strictly to 127.0.0.1 by default; remote network access requires --lan or explicit --bind <ip>.

nodes.label: Reverse-Proxy Awareness (v0.6.2)
nodes.rationale: Trusted proxy peers declared via --trusted-proxies so rate limiting keys on the real client IP from X-Forwarded-For; forwarded headers from untrusted peers are ignored; wildcard Host entries are opt-in with a trust-delegation warning.

nodes.label: Supply-Chain Verification (v0.6.2)
nodes.rationale: Releases ship checksums.txt.minisig; install.sh/update.sh verify the signature against the committed pubkey before trusting SHA-256 sums so tampering aborts hard; MUX_WEB_STRICT_VERIFY=1 refuses unsigned installs.

nodes.label: SOC 2 TSC Control Mapping
nodes.rationale: Explicitly notes SOC 1/2/3 are organizational audits; this release supplies engineering controls plus evidence trail, not certification.

nodes.label: GPG/cosign Installer Signature
nodes.rationale: Installer tanpa signature/GPG tercatat sebagai gap supply-chain M4; implementasi sengaja ditunda ke rilis lanjutan (spec 004)

nodes.label: Opsi A — Phased Iterative Release
